method: Use multistart SLSQP with analytic gradients to maximize the sum of 26 independent radii under exact boundary and pairwise non-overlap constraints, initializing from perturbed grids and staggered rows.

Apply basin hopping to locally optimized packings: repeatedly relocate a small circle or perturb a cluster, restore feasibility with constrained optimization, and retain improvements or occasional uphill moves.

Run a continuation-based soft-circle search using L-BFGS to minimize overlap and boundary penalties minus a radius reward, progressively increase penalty weights, then polish with exact constrained optimization.

Enumerate staggered-row layouts with different circle counts per row, optimize shared row heights, horizontal offsets, and radii, then release all coordinates and radii for final constrained optimization.

Use sequential convex programming: fix pairwise separation directions, maximize the sum of radii under linear projected-separation and boundary constraints plus a trust region, then update directions and repeat from several feasible initial packings.

Search contact-graph topologies by solving circle–circle and circle–wall tangency equations, checking all omitted non-overlap constraints, and generating neighboring candidates through contact-edge additions, deletions, and flips.

Construct packings from reflection- or rotation-symmetric circle orbits, optimize the reduced coordinates and radii for several orbit decompositions totaling 26 circles, then release symmetry for final constrained polishing.

Run a population-based genetic search that forms 26-circle offspring by spatially splicing complementary regions of two parent packings, repairs overlaps, locally optimizes each offspring, and retains high-scoring geometrically diverse survivors.

Use cardinality-changing search: optimize intermediate packings with 25–28 circles, insert circles at maximal-clearance points or delete circles according to their reoptimized removal cost, and return to 26 circles before exact constrained polishing.

Build packings with beam search over tangent-circle insertions, generating candidates tangent to triples of existing circles or square walls, retaining diverse partial packings, and jointly optimizing each completed 26-circle layout.

Use domain-shape continuation by optimizing packings in unit-area rectangles of varying aspect ratio, tracking multiple solution branches as each rectangle deforms back into the unit square, and polishing the resulting square packings.

Continue the successful genetic search with geometry-aware crossover: align parents under square symmetries and minimum-cost circle matching, select complementary spatial subsets totaling exactly 26 circles, then repair and locally optimize while preserving contact-pattern diversity.
